def factor_cycle_skewness_bounded(df):
    """Slow-moving return distribution asymmetry, bounded by normalizing skewness."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    skew = ret.rolling(120, min_periods=60).skew()
    factor = skew / (1.0 + skew.abs())
    df_copy["factor_cycle_skewness_bounded"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_cycle_skewness_bounded"]
